name: O*NET Database (tasks; DWAs; Emerging Tasks; technology skills)
what_it_illuminates: Task-level content of US occupations; emerging task statements as a change signal
integration_detail: SSSOM map EMST L2 tasks to O*NET task IDs (skos:closeMatch/narrowMatch) and L3 roles to O*NET-SOC; ingest Emerging Tasks as L5 emergence candidates; re-validate mappings each quarterly release

name: O*NET Web Services 2.0
what_it_illuminates: API access to occupations; keyword search; crosswalks
integration_detail: Use for occupation lookup and keyword-to-SOC suggestions in the review UI; never as the canonical store (data release files are)

name: ESCO classification (skills; occupations; RDF/SKOS)
what_it_illuminates: Multilingual skill/occupation concepts with typed relations and green-skill labels
latest_release_or_status: v1.2.1 (Dec 2025; CA-030); IA used v1.2.0 data
integration_detail: SSSOM EMST competencies -> ESCO skills (crosswalks/emst_v1_to_esco_skill.*.sssom.tsv); pin object_source_version; chain to O*NET via the official crosswalk; gaps (Tribal consultation, wildland fire, AI validation) are evidence of where EMST adds value

name: ESCO-O*NET Crosswalk (occupations) v1
what_it_illuminates: Human-curated SKOS-typed occupation equivalences (4269 rows)
integration_detail: Reuse as a chaining bridge (EMST role -> O*NET-SOC -> ESCO occupation) and as a model for match-type distributions (broadMatch most common)

name: Credential Registry and CTDL/CTDL-ASN
what_it_illuminates: Links between competencies; credentials; occupations; work roles; tasks
latest_release_or_status: CTDL significant update Jan 2025; registry live
integration_detail: Publish EMST as a ceasn:CompetencyFramework with CTIDs (ce-UUIDv5 of EMST IRIs); ask CE to host RSD renderings; harvest credentials aligned to EMST competencies as curriculum-coverage signals

name: OSMT and Rich Skill Descriptors
what_it_illuminates: Collections of skill statements used by colleges and employers
integration_detail: Offer an RSD export of every EMST competency so OSMT users can import it; collect OSMT alignments back as SSSOM

name: Open Skills Network (community of practice)
what_it_illuminates: Practitioner community for open skills (700+ organizations per WGU)
latest_release_or_status: Continues under WGU after RSD/OSMT transfer
integration_detail: Recruit pilot adopters for RSD exports; venue for interoperability testing

name: 1EdTech CASE 1.1 (and CASE adopters)
what_it_illuminates: How curricula/assessments reference competency frameworks
integration_detail: CASE package export for LMS/assessment vendors and universities (LC); lossy association mapping documented

name: Open Badges 3.0 / Verifiable Credentials 2.0
what_it_illuminates: How issued credentials claim competencies
integration_detail: Credential issuers align badges to EMST IRIs (Alignment.targetType ceasn:Competency or CFItem); EMST later ingests counts of aligned badges as supply signals

name: IEEE 1484.20.3 Competency Data Standards WG
owner_or_host: IEEE SA Learning Technology Standards Committee
what_it_illuminates: Formal competency definition model; open application profiles via 20.3a
integration_detail: Contribute an EMST application profile once 20.3a allows open supporting documents

name: SSSOM / mapping-commons and SEMAPV
what_it_illuminates: Mapping provenance; justification vocabulary incl. LLM-based matching
integration_detail: All EMST crosswalks published as SSSOM/TSV; propose an EMST registry entry; use sssom-py tooling in CI

name: w3id.org permanent identifier service
what_it_illuminates: Persistent IRIs independent of hosting
integration_detail: Register /emst/ redirects to the published release site; IDs survive host or steward changes

name: OpenLMP plan components
sector_focus: Federal and state land management plans (western US; 95% USFS)
what_it_illuminates: What plans require of the workforce (standards; guidelines; monitoring)
integration_detail: Link components to EMST competencies/tasks (prototype); emit plan-requirement ChangeSignals with linker precision attached; propagate OpenLMP extraction confidence

name: Nesta Skills Extractor (ojd_daps_skills)
what_it_illuminates: Open skills extraction + taxonomy mapping with documented failure modes
integration_detail: Compare EMST pipeline against its NER+embedding design; reuse its model-card format for EMST linker releases

name: Nesta skills-taxonomy-v2 (bottom-up taxonomy from adverts)
what_it_illuminates: Taxonomy induced from postings by clustering
latest_release_or_status: Code public; cannot be rerun (licensed data withdrawn)
integration_detail: Methods precedent for emergence clusters; cautionary case for licensed posting data

name: SkillSpan dataset and guidelines
owner_or_host: IT University of Copenhagen (Zhang et al.)
sector_focus: English tech and house job postings
what_it_illuminates: Span-level hard/soft skill annotation
integration_detail: Adapt guidelines for an EMST environmental-postings span set; evaluate span extractors before linking

name: Skill extraction benchmarks TECH/HOUSE/TECHWOLF (ESCO-linked)
what_it_illuminates: ESCO-linked skill mentions for linking evaluation
integration_detail: Sanity-check any EMST linker on a public ESCO benchmark before trusting it on EMST targets

name: MELO benchmark (entity linking of occupations)
what_it_illuminates: Occupation linking evaluation; lexical vs encoder baselines
integration_detail: Model the EMST role-linking evaluation (O*NET/OPM/state titles to EMST roles) on MELO's query/corpus/annotation layout

name: IReRa (Infer-Retrieve-Rank) program
what_it_illuminates: LLM-plus-retriever linking with ~50 labeled examples
integration_detail: Template for the EMST LLM stage (retrieve top-k EMST concepts; LLM ranks with rationale); evaluate on the EMST gold set

name: ESCOXLM-R language model
what_it_illuminates: Taxonomy-driven pretraining for skill/occupation tasks
integration_detail: Candidate encoder for a fine-tuned EMST linker once a larger gold set exists (model weights on HuggingFace; not reachable from this environment)

name: Lightcast Open Skills
what_it_illuminates: Fast-moving tool/technology skills
integration_detail: Optional L4 tools crosswalk subject to licence; never canonical; store IDs only if terms allow

name: USAJOBS API (Search; Historic JOA)
what_it_illuminates: Federal demand by series/grade/agency over time
integration_detail: Primary federal posting source: pull announcements by series (0401; 0408; 0460; 0486; 0819; 1350 ...); link duties/qualifications text; aggregate by quarter

name: JDX JobSchema+ (jdx vocabulary)
what_it_illuminates: Competency-referenced job requirements
integration_detail: Target shape for EMST role-profile exports and a structured-posting input

name: Enterprise HCM skills engines (Workday Skills Cloud; SAP SuccessFactors Talent Intelligence Hub; Oracle HCM; Eightfold)
what_it_illuminates: How employers' systems infer and store skills
integration_detail: Deliver EMST as an importable skills library (CSV + stable IDs + version) and ask vendors to export their EMST mappings as SSSOM for audit; verify each import path in the NGO/agency pilot

name: esco-skill-extractor (PyPI)
what_it_illuminates: Embedding-based ESCO extraction; convenient ESCO v1.2.0 bundle
integration_detail: Used as the offline ESCO data source for the IA crosswalk prototype (hash-pinned)

name: skills-ml (Workforce Data Initiative)
what_it_illuminates: Early open US skills-extraction toolkit
integration_detail: Cautionary precedent: open tooling without a steward lapses (AS year-five question)
